_about: The Windows programs Install-Prereqs.ps1 installs, pinned so a saved copy can be kept (Jake 7:53 PM CT 11/26, Decision 174 B: 'we always back up our functionality, reference, calibration materials and all components'). Each entry is the exact x64 installer file winget's signed manifest names for the pinned version, with that manifest's InstallerSha256. build_saved_release.py --kind programs downloads each from its url, refuses any sha256 or byte count other than the pin, and saves it to the private release programs-v1. bytes null = not measured yet (the original site is not reachable from where this list was written); the release build then measures it and reports it in measured_pins.json, and only a reviewed commit makes it a pin. 'measured' says where each pin was read. mutool is installed from this saved copy first; the others keep winget at the same pin, with the saved copy as the backup.
